normal.name: CJ @ Cuirass Entertainment
normal.text: For those who never used this system, it was unique. It was a #linux system with low specs and a front end store where users could buy and play their games. It was an excellent place to cut my teeth with indie development because it had passionate players and a supportive community. I am not kidding when I say End's Reach would not have existed without those people. Ironically, we need low spec indie friendly platforms more than ever now with the rising costs of #gaming hardware. Oh well!

normal.name: hush404
normal.text: Very sad, but not terribly surprised that EA has shut down #bioware. EA has been a mess for a while... Their recent buyout, I expect, is just further running it into the ground. That's fine. I've not cared much for EA of recent mind, but bioware is an ol fave. Mass Effect was and always will be one of my favortire franchises. That said, my hope is that #masseffect as an IP is sold off to continue later. Else, I hope #exodus by #ArchetypeEntertainment really steps in to have that spirit live on! #gaming #videogames #SadNews
